text:
Nora (Marketing Ops): Quick sync 10m1 1May micro-workshop is scheduled. Need final reg page, Zoom recording + SRT stream, and post-event routing by Fri COB. Main asks: two CTAs, company-size gating, 10-day open replay then gated, clip owners, and GDPR consent.
Alex (Growth): Suggested CTAs: primary 'Register 1 Free' (always), secondary 'Request demo' (show when company_size == 500+).
Priya (Design): I uploaded a compact hero + mobile-first variants: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/micro-workshop-hero. Design keeps form at 6 fields max.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Form fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, company_size (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, gdpr_consent (required). Hidden field: source_detail = "micro-workshop-may10". Add ICS + Google Calendar buttons.
Alex (Growth): HubSpot mapping: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail. UTM: utm_campaign=micro_workshop_may10. Routing rule: company_size == '500+' -> queue=ae_inbound, else -> sdr_inbound.
Diego (Sales): For 500+ leads, please include a conversation starter: "interested in latency/cost tradeoffs" in AE notes. Also send AE alert when registrant attends live.
Sam (Events): Zoom plan: cloud recording + audio transcript enabled. Enable "Optimize for 3rd party captions" so we can get SRT. Local host recording as fallback. I'll create meeting and SRT stream to srt://ingest.redwood.internal:9010/ws10.
RegBot: Meeting created https://zoom.us/j/8889990000 (ID: 888-999-0000). SRT test scheduled May 8 09:30 PT.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Replay policy: Day 0-10 open public replay URL; Day 11 switch to gated replay (email unlock) and make full-length download available to gated users. Clips stay available (public) after day 11.
Priya (Design): Need speaker headshots and 3 crop sizes for clip thumbnails. Who owns clip extraction?
Sam (Events): I'll own extraction + timecode notes live. Diego, Alex you own final clip titles.
Alex (Growth): Post-event flow: 0-24h send replay + CTA to book demo. Day 7 send highlights and AE nudge for 500+ who attended. Day 11 require email to view full replay.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Export columns: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size_segment, utm_campaign, registration_ts, session_id, attended_live. Daily HS import.
Alex (Growth): Add attendance rule: joined > 5 minutes -> attended_live = true. Hook via Zoom webhook to HS.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Privacy copy: "I agree to receive event-related emails and content." Save checkbox to HS property gdpr_consent. Must be required.
Priya (Design): Also include a micro copy under the form: "Open replay available for 10 days" with a small countdown widget after signup.
Sam (Events): Infra confirmed for SRT port 9010 from Zoom IPs. I'll run an SRT end-to-end test 48h prior and again 6h prior.
RegBot: Reminder: SRT end-to-end test scheduled May 8 09:30 PT and dress rehearsal May 9 10:00 PT.
Diego (Sales): Can we add a hidden field for company_employee_count to help segmentation downstream?
Nora (Marketing Ops): Yes hidden numeric field company_employee_count. Make sure devs validate as integer.
Alex (Growth): HubSpot workflow checklist: map hidden fields, tag 'event:micro_workshop_may10', set company_size_segment from dropdown, route >500 to ae_inbound with conversation starter property.
Priya (Design): I'll deliver thumbnails to Sam by EOD Thursday.
Sam (Events): Lock reg page + email copy by Friday 12pm PT so I can run integration test.
Nora (Marketing Ops): Assigning owners in Asana: Nora=reg page + HS fields, Priya=hero + thumbnails, Sam=Zoom + clips + SRT, Alex=emails + HS routing, Diego=AE brief + clip titles. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Priya (Design): :white_check_mark:
Sam (Events): :white_check_mark:
Alex (Growth): :white_check_mark:
Diego (Sales): :white_check_mark:
Nora (Marketing Ops): Thanks team. If SRT fails we fall back to cloud transcript + local recording; Sam will copy assets to S3 and apply 10-day public -> gated at day 11 policy. Close after Asana tasks confirmed.
